capabilities: Edit LaTeX source files with CodeMirror 6 syntax highlighting
Compile projects with latexmk or Tectonic backends
Preview the generated PDF in a side-by-side pane
Parse diagnostics and jump to the first compilation error
disambiguation: Not for rendering LaTeX math inside Markdown notes; it edits and compiles standalone LaTeX projects.
extras: Desktop-only (needs Obsidian 1.8+). Compiles run local executables without a shell; the README warns against enabling shell escape unless you understand the consequences. Tectonic may download packages from its bundle service when not cached. No telemetry, accounts, or ads; the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no way to edit full LaTeX projects, run a local TeX compiler, or view the resulting PDF inside the vault.

relations.evidence: latexmk and Tectonic backends with safe argument-based process execution
latexmk and Tectonic backends with safe argument-based process execution
Overleaf-style side-by-side workspace with a live, reusable PDF preview

requires.name: latexmk (TeX Live, MacTeX, or MiKTeX) or Tectonic on PATH

summary: LaTeX workspace that edits .tex, .sty, and .cls files, compiles them with local latexmk or Tectonic, and previews the PDF beside the editor.
